responsibility: This file implements the stateful pretty-printing engine used by the mc code generator. It owns the concrete pretty-printer object carrying write callbacks, indentation level, pending-space and pending-indent flags, current output position and line counters, and a stack link for speculative copies; it provides initialization, duplication, push/pop, indentation control, and text emission with newline escape handling, making it the formatting core used by decl and keyc when generating target-language source.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file implements the opaque pretty-printer abstraction declared in GmcPretty.h: it defines the internal pretty object fields and the logic for spacing, indentation, line/column tracking, stack push/pop, and escape-aware output.
